verdict.rationale: The evidence documents CPU optimizations only for x86 (AVX/AVX2/AVX512/AMX) and ARM (NEON on Apple silicon); nothing mentions PowerPC or any other CPU architecture. The dependency-free C/C++ implementation suggests portability, but that is only an adjacent property, not documented support for other architectures.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run inference on diverse CPU architectures beyond x86 and ARM, such as PowerPC
